title: Yellow Gigantes Beans in Tomato Sauce
description: A traditional Greek recipe featuring giant beans cooked in a flavorful tomato sauce. This hearty dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add soaked and drained gigantes, plaki, salt, and pepper.
Pour in enough water to cover the beans and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 45-50 minutes, or until beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
